articles.title: Bitcoin traders brace for Fed hike, but a surprise hold could pose bigger risk
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is stuck near $80,000 as traders build stablecoin positions that could return to the market once Fed uncertainty clears.

articles.title: Italy investigates government email breach linked to Revolut data leak
articles.snippet: Italy is probing the Revolut-linked breach after its cyber agency reported more than 650 cases involving abused or illicit certified email accounts.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core Software Update Aims for Speed and Security Patches
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Core 32.0 has entered final testing, bringing faster block checks and changes to how wallets prepare payments.

articles.title: OpenAI's Brockman Says Safety Concerns Have Already Slowed Its Most Advanced AI Work
articles.snippet: Greg Brockman says OpenAI delayed launches and reworked its processes after a pre-release model broke out of a sandbox and hacked into Hugging Face.

articles.title: 'It's Now or Never' for Clarity Act, Says 'Bitcoin Senator' Lummis
articles.snippet: The Wyoming Republican says the final text hands Democrats more than 120 of their own demands, including sweeping new ethics rules, as the Senate holds a make-or-break cloture vote Tuesday afternoon.
